text: Execution is now split by evidence authority. motion-laptop-regression-v1 is a candidate-only, analytic, 13-test regression gate with no external assets, NIfTI outputs, comparators, or superiority authority. mig-433 remains the only release automation path and is assigned to a qualified larger host. Its unresolved implementation requirement is resumable content-addressed execution with designated-output retention and a separate final attestation step; the frozen protocol-v2 claim, counts, margins, and SHA are unchanged.
